### [`rank_number_table`](../../../../src/game/panel_texts_1c62.asm#L144) `$1D3C-$1D47`

*data*

Rank number of each rank index: 0, 1-10, 10. Only 12 entries; the rank index goes up to 22, so ranks 12-22 read the code of ai_update.
